capabilities: Browse .yaml and .yml files as a structured tree
Filter tree nodes by key, value, or YAML path
Navigate large files with a right-side outline
View raw YAML with syntax highlighting and line numbers
Copy raw YAML or individual YAML paths to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a YAML editor or form; it only displays YAML files and cannot write changes to disk.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README also documents clipboard and privacy behavior (no network requests, clipboard writes only on explicit copy actions).
motivation: YAML files often contain comments, anchors, ordering, and formatting that a form editor could destroy by reserializing, so the author built a viewer that never writes back to disk.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated view for YAML files, and editing them risks reformatting or losing comments, anchors, and ordering that matter.

relations.evidence: For beta testing, install the plugin with BRAT using this repository URL

summary: Read-only viewer that opens .yaml and .yml files as a searchable tree with an outline panel and syntax-highlighted raw source.
